lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the branchial region, with higher density and smaller diameter clusters located dorsally and larger clusters located along the lateral midline.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse high-intensity pixels intersecting with the horizontal rows of circular spots, forming distinct nodes of higher luminance.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp transition from high-intensity pixels on the upper edge to low-intensity pixels on the lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Clustered linear high-luminance streaks on the anterior lateral flank, indicative of physical trauma or surface abrasions.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple secondary biological signatures (remoras) are visible near the pectoral fin and ventral-lateral surface.
